name: Lúbadh expander
source: Lubadh-Manual-Firmare-V2-A5-.pdf p6 (CV Expansion Module key), p13
notes: 2HP CV Expansion Module, connected to Lúbadh by 12-pin ribbon. Top four jacks are the left deck, bottom four the right deck. ERASE is a trigger/gate input that erases that deck's buffer. Inputs only, no outputs. (The separate USB expander has no patch jacks.)
